entities.name: 2020 COVID-19 pandemic in Mayotte
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic was confirmed to have reached the French overseas department and region of Mayotte on 10 March 2020. On 31 March, the first person died of COVID-19. In late April, the virus was out of control, and actively circulating on the island. On 16 August, Mayotte has been green listed.
